title: UserSessionsClosed
description: Some of the account's sessions were closed from another device; those installs must sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

installation_ids.description: Installs whose sessions were closed; never empty.

reason.title: SessionsClosedReason
reason.description: Why the sessions were closed; only a sign-out from another device today.
